sweptClasses.sample: whether Gitea's issue-comment endpoint returns every comment unbounded or applies an undocumented server-side cap could not be established this run (no live-docs access, and no live Gitea may be touched), so listIssueComments sends no page params to Gitea and the dedupe's coverage there is unverified rather than assured

recordFailedWriteback compares only the immediately preceding outcome, so a forge alternating ambiguous and definite failures writes one 回写 ok:false row per poller tick indefinitely; growth is bounded by outcome transitions, not absolutely

once an ambiguous outcome is stored, a permanently failing listIssueComments makes the write-back retry the listing forever without posting and without writing any new event, so the audit timeline shows one row then silence, indistinguishable from convergence
